literal_meaning: লাগাম ছাড়া (ঘোড়ার লাগাম ছাড়া অর্থাত্ নিয়ন্ত্রণহীন)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার আচরণ সম্পূর্ণ লাগামছাড়া হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There is an uncontrolled price hike in the market.
His behavior has become completely unrestrained.
note: The idiom draws from imagery of horses in rural settings, common in Bengali agrarian culture.
